name: flash-sale
description: Flash-sale system: convenience scripts only. Dependencies live in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.reset-sale: docker compose run --rm init node src/scripts/resetSale.js
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.up:scaled: docker compose up -d --build --scale api=3 --scale worker=2 && docker compose restart nginx
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.reconcile: docker compose run --rm init node src/scripts/reconcileInventory.js
scripts.reconcile:apply: docker compose run --rm init node src/scripts/reconcileInventory.js --apply
scripts.bundle-size: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run size
